improvements: The Belvedere factory water tower is a district landmark on its mapped outline: a weathered grey-beige rendered shaft with flat pilasters and one vertical row of small windows, under a wider tank head with round windows, a cornice and a low cone roof. It replaces the generic round building with eight window rows.
remainingGaps: The mapped outline (r 5.6 m) is the tank head; the shaft radius (0.75 of the head) and every band height are estimates from the panorama (viewed only). The 30 m top is OSM's.
